# SEVERE SINUSITIS

Community-acquired bacterial sinusitis is most often due to Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenza or Moraxella catarrhalis. Group A Streptococci, Staphylococcus aureus and anaerobes are isolated less frequently.
For patients who present with severe symptoms (high fever (>/= 102 degrees Fahrenheit, >/= 39 degrees Celsius) and purulent nasal discharge for 3-4 consecutive days or facial pain lasting for at least 3-4 consecutive days at the beginning of illness), initiate empiric antimicrobials and obtain CT of sinuses to determine the extent of infection. If the CT shows extension of sinusitis infection into surrounding structures (i.e. the cranium or orbit) consult ENT immediately. Closely monitor all patients who present with severe signs and symptoms to ensure that signs and symptoms improve within 72 hours.

---

Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Outpatient Treatment

Preferred:

[Amoxicillin/clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h \($\) R for 7 days](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)

Alternatives:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h \($\) R for 7 days](psjzid-cefdinir-300mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID  \($\) DI for 7 days](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)

### Treatment of hospitalized patient

Preferred:

[Ampicillin-sulbactam 3gm IV q6h \($\) R for 7 days](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-q6h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h \($\) M for 7 days](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h)

### Treatment failure

If symptoms worsen or no improvement is seen after 3-5 days of treatment, broaden coverage, switch to different antimicrobial class and treat 10 days. If symptoms continue to worsen or there is no improvement after 3-5 more days of treatment, obtain CT to investigate non-infectious or suppurative causes. ENT consultation is recommended. If sinuses are aspirated, specimens should be cultured.

Preferred
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q6h \($$\) R](psjizid-pip-taz-3-375-gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
for 7 days
< OR >
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q12h \($$\) R for 7 days](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q12h)
